name: AI Search Block
description: Provides a block for AI search functionality.
project_description: AI Search Block turns a Search API index of your site content into a natural-language answer box. A visitor types a question; the module retrieves the most relevant indexed chunks/entities (RAG), feeds them to a configured chat LLM through the drupal/ai provider abstraction, and streams back an HTML answer that links to the source pages. It ships as two paired blocks: an AI Search form block (the question input) and an AI Search Response block (where the streamed answer appears), so you decide layout independently. Retrieval is tunable (score threshold, minimum/maximum results, optional bi-encoder reranking, retrieval prefix templates for asymmetric embedding models), the aggregation prompt is fully editable with entity/user/date placeholders, and an optional traditional Drupal View can render classic keyword results below the AI answer. Four submodules extend it: ai_search_block_extras (textarea UX), ai_search_block_header (a header search box that redirects into the AI block), ai_search_block_log (stores every question/answer/prompt with visitor scoring and admin analytics), and ai_search_block_log_tag (queue/cron AI classification of logged questions into your own tag vocabulary).
